reason: An automation plugin for DeepSeek Harness that manages configured LLM provider failover, cooldowns, fallback models, settings, and switch notifications.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可配置的模型提供方故障转移、冷却、模型映射、永久兜底和切换提示功能。
summaries.en: Provides configurable LLM provider failover for DeepSeek Harness with cooldowns, per-provider model mappings, a permanent fallback, and switch notices.

capabilities: Automatically switches configured LLM providers after qualifying rate-limit or quota failures
Applies per-provider model mappings and cooldowns during request handling
Persists schema-validated plugin settings through the standard settings service
Displays an in-UI notice when provider switching occurs
